requirements.requirement: The system must define a fixed enumeration of clinical trial statuses including RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, and UNKNOWN.
The system must assign a numeric score weight to each status category in the schema.
The system must ensure score weights are normalized to a consistent range (e.g., 0.0 to 1.0).
The system must define RECRUITING as the highest-weighted status in the schema.
The system must define TERMINATED as lower-weighted than COMPLETED in the schema.
The system must include an explicit mapping field in the schema linking raw API status values to normalized status categories.
The system must define an output contract that includes at minimum: normalized_status, score, and original_status.
The system must ensure the output contract is serializable as JSON for downstream consumers.
The system must document the schema structure and field definitions within the codebase for developer reference.
The system must default to UNKNOWN status when an input status value does not match any defined category.
The system must assign a valid score weight to UNKNOWN status within the normalized range.
The system must ensure that the schema supports deterministic lookup of score weight by normalized status.
The system must handle null or missing status inputs by mapping them to UNKNOWN without throwing an error.
The system must prevent undefined or extra status categories from being included in the schema at runtime.
